# MockPit

MockPit is a TypeScript package family for runtime provenance devtools. It records,
visualises, and exports the source of visible data in prototype applications so teams can
see whether a screen is using live API data, MSW mocks, fixture fallbacks, derived values,
hardcoded copy, empty responses, unsupported capabilities, errors, or unknown sources.

Primary docs:
- /docs/intro - concept, source taxonomy, and mental model
- /docs/quick-start - install, configure, create a client, mount devtools, instrument fetch
- /docs/react - React provider, hooks, AuditMark, AuditSection, MockPitDevtools
- /docs/msw - MSW worker setup, withMockPitHandler, critical routes, cleanup
- /docs/configuration - resources, sections, capture policies, scenarios, redaction
- /docs/modes - mock, hybrid, live, audit, and capture modes
- /docs/cli - mockpit init, doctor, and audit
- /docs/ai-agent-conventions - rules for AI-assisted MockPit projects

Package names:
- @mockpit/core
- @mockpit/browser
- @mockpit/devtools
- @mockpit/react
- @mockpit/msw
- @mockpit/cli

Important API note: the React AuditMark component currently accepts a prop named `source`,
not `sourceKind`.
